description_en: Creates an integrated image-to-image search task
description_zh: 调用该接口创建一体化以图搜图任务
name: CreatePictureSearchJob

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the image search application instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206608.html to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 以图搜图应用实例ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206608.html查询
parameters.name: app_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to be searched
parameters.name: search_pic_url

parameters.help_en: The start time of the search range. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 检索范围起始时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the search range. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 检索范围结束时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The face search threshold. Valid values: 0 to 1.

To ensure the accuracy of search results, set this parameter to a value between 0.3 and 0.6
parameters.help_zh:
人脸检索阈值。取值范围为0~1。

为保证检索结果的准确性，推荐设置该参数在0.3~0.6之间
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en:
The body search threshold. Valid values: 0 to 1.

To ensure the accuracy of search results, set this parameter to a value greater than or equal to 0.8. If this parameter is not specified, the value of the Threshold parameter is used
parameters.help_zh:
人体检索阈值。取值范围为0~1。

为保证检索结果的准确性，推荐设置该参数大于等于0.8。若不设置，则取值为Threshold参数的值
parameters.name: body_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The search type. Valid values:

1: face
0: body

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
检索类型：

1：人脸
0：人体

默认为1
parameters.name: picture_search_type
